text: The best! Clean and simple with wear os connection without annoying adds
author: Artur Base
developer_reply: Hey! Thanks for your review! Enjoy!

text: I miss some features, like encryption or password protection, setting a start time for the day, editing past entries, and a day tab (for checking past days). Despite this, I really appreciate the app; it's fast, free, and aesthetically pleasing, standing out from other apps of this type (and I've seen many).
author: Daniel S.
developer_reply: Hello Daniel! Thanks for your feedback! We just released an update that would allow you to edit past entries. We are still working to improve the app, so bear with us.
